description.summary: A spectral shield appears, composed of pure holy energy that guards you from attacks
description.value: A spectral shield appears, composed of pure holy energy that guards you from attacks. While active, this shield provides the user a +1 bonus to AC, plus an additional 1 for every 5 caster levels. Any time you are struck for damage by a melee attack by an adjacent attacker, this shield batters the attacker. It has a base attack bonus equal to your caster level plus your Strength modifier or Charisma modifier (your choice). It deals 1d6 + Str or Cha modifier damage (your choice). The shield cannot be attacked or harmed by physical attacks, but dispel affects it.
